column10: dig_threshold_desc:I tended to try and collect more than 4 or 5 gems per dig. At first I was collecting until 1 or more
column11: but I adjusted this as the game went on.
column13: surprise_desc:If the amount of gems didn't decrease quickly
column14: I would keep digging so I could minimize my time spent traveling between planets.
column18: other_desc:The main strategy I used was to mine as many gems as I could on each planet while trying not to get too few so I could minimize my time travelling between each planet. I also tried to spend as little time possible in home base to maximize how many gems I could mine.
column19: feedback:Sometimes it was a little slow to respond
column20: but overall it was interesting and made you think whether to adjust your strategy as the game went on.}
